applied_filters.name: refund_chain_lands_in_home_north
applied_filters.scope: entity population selected by existence on fact 'refunds' via roles customer.home_region; applied to this metric through its own roles customer.home_region (independent semi-join, no fact-to-fact join)

base_plans.intermediate_grain: rows of fact 'refunds' aligned to dimensions ['customer']; native fact multiplicity preserved, LEFT JOINs are many-to-one
base_plans.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(f__customer."customer_id", '__metriclayer__::missing_member__') AS "dim__customer", 1 AS "measure"
  FROM "refunds" f
  LEFT JOIN "customers" f__customer ON f__customer."customer_id" = f."customer_id"
  LEFT JOIN "regions" f__customer__home_region ON f__customer__home_region."region_id" = f__customer."home_region_id"
  WHERE f__customer__home_region."region_id" IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT sf__customer__home_region."region_id"
    FROM "refunds" "sf"
    LEFT JOIN "customers" sf__customer ON sf__customer."customer_id" = sf."customer_id"
    LEFT JOIN "regions" sf__customer__home_region ON sf__customer__home_region."region_id" = sf__customer."home_region_id"
    WHERE sf."region_id" = ?
      AND sf__customer__home_region."region_id" IS NOT NULL
  )

base_plans.intermediate_grain: rows of fact 'shipments' aligned to dimensions ['customer']; native fact multiplicity preserved, LEFT JOINs are many-to-one
base_plans.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(f__customer."customer_id", '__metriclayer__::missing_member__') AS "dim__customer", "f"."amount" AS "measure", CASE WHEN "f"."amount" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "measure_is_null"
  FROM "shipments" f
  LEFT JOIN "customers" f__customer ON f__customer."customer_id" = f."customer_id"
  LEFT JOIN "regions" f__customer__home_region ON f__customer__home_region."region_id" = f__customer."home_region_id"
  WHERE f__customer__home_region."region_id" IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT sf__customer__home_region."region_id"
    FROM "refunds" "sf"
    LEFT JOIN "customers" sf__customer ON sf__customer."customer_id" = sf."customer_id"
    LEFT JOIN "regions" sf__customer__home_region ON sf__customer__home_region."region_id" = sf__customer."home_region_id"
    WHERE sf."region_id" = ?
      AND sf__customer__home_region."region_id" IS NOT NULL
  )

read_view: single SQLite read transaction; one read-only connection per query, all per-fact SQL run against the same snapshot
notes: each base metric reads exactly one fact table at its native row grain; facts are never joined to facts
existence filters compile to independent NOT/IN semi-joins; two existence filters are evaluated independently and may be satisfied by different fact rows
